description: luismc-docs: SessionStart hands the agent the documentation rule and the project-artifacts rule; Stop warns when mapped code changed without its docs, a change note or `Docs: none` (DOCSPEC section 8.2), and keeps Full Progress published; after commands the hooks queue status events, note background work and stamp the turn start. Docs hooks are opt-in: nothing happens in a project without docs/docs.json. No hook commits, pushes or runs any git or gh write (ARTIFACTSPEC 1.10.0, section 8).

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_stop.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_stop.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_end_of_turn.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_end_of_turn.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_session_start.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_session_start.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/artifacts/hook_session_start.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/artifacts/hook_session_start.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_after_command.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_after_command.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_after_command.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_after_command.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_turn_start.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook_turn_start.py"; fi
